id, title, author, dynasty, genre, theme, quote, content, translation, analysis, tags, cover_url as coverUrl, season, emotion, scenery, festival, historical_period as historicalPeriod, poetic_form as poeticForm, rhetorical_device as rhetoricalDevice, hot
mapper.select: select from poem where title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from poem where author like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from poem where quote is not null and quote like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from poem where content is not null and content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from poem where author like concat('%', #{author}, '%') and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select from poem where ( theme like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') or season like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') or emotion like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') or scenery like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') or tags like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') or quote like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') or content like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') ) order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from poem where ( quote like concat('%', #{summary}, '%') or content like concat('%', #{summary}, '%') or analysis like concat('%', #{summary}, '%') ) order by hot desc, id desc limit #{limit}
